selection_rule: The four listed source-design candidates fill dbd-postgres-hd-01..04 in order. Each case uses exactly eight unique current PostgreSQL-authored extension control files, four required plus four distractors, with four producers each receiving one required and one distractor. The ordered answer is the exact default_version declared by the four required control files. Selection uses source/design facts only; no confirmatory treatment or evaluator outcomes may be observed or used; source-byte reuse with any selected confirmatory case is forbidden.
